name: Please Miss Me
source:
You play as Rebekka, a snarky woman with a terrible secret. Rebekka has the infectious Nosebleed, a death sentence to those who acquire it. The disease makes the victim violent and with one goal; to spread. Despite knowing that she is a ticking time bomb, Rebekka hides her illness and acts normal. When you begin, Rebekka and her sister, Iris, are tasked with checking the old shed outside of their family home. You must decide what path Rebekka takes.

[From [url=https://doppiooh.itch.io/please-miss-me]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你将扮演说话带刺、藏着可怕秘密的丽贝卡。她染上了会传染的“鼻血病”，患上这种病几乎就等于被判了死刑。病人会变得暴躁凶狠，只剩下一个念头：把病传出去。丽贝卡明知自己随时可能发作，仍然隐瞒病情，装作一切如常。故事开始时，丽贝卡和艾丽丝姐妹俩受托去看看自家屋外的旧棚子。丽贝卡接下来走哪条路，要由你决定。

〔摘自[url=https://doppiooh.itch.io/please-miss-me]itch.io[/url]〕
